description: You are an accessibility engineer at a digital consulting firm contracted to assess WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for federal government websites. Using Safari's built-in Web Inspector Audit tool (Audit tab in Web Inspector), run a full accessibility audit on each of the following four sites: www.ssa.gov, www.medicare.gov, www.va.gov, and www.benefits.gov. For each site, record the total number of audit issues reported, the count broken down by type (Errors, Warnings, Comments), and at least three specific issue descriptions verbatim from the audit panel. Save the results as JSON to ~/Documents/federal_accessibility_audit.json, with one object per site keyed by domain.
